::: {#fig-doubling-die}

```{r}
#| label: doubling-die-alt
#| include: false
fig_alt <- paste(
  "A scatter plot of six points,",
  "one for each die roll from 1 to 6 on the horizontal axis,",
  "rising along a straight line at heights 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 and 12.",
  "Dotted lines carry each height across to the vertical axis,",
  "where the image of the function is marked."
)
```

```{r}
#| label: doubling-die-plot
#| fig-alt: !expr fig_alt
rolls <- data.frame(roll = 1:6, double = 2 * (1:6))

doubling_die_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(rolls) +
  ggplot2::aes(x = roll, y = double) +
  ggplot2::geom_segment(
    ggplot2::aes(xend = 0, yend = double),
    linetype = "dotted",
    colour = "grey50"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    ggplot2::aes(colour = "graph of f"),
    size = 3
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    ggplot2::aes(x = 0, colour = "image of f"),
    shape = 15,
    size = 3
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:6, limits = c(0, 6)) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 12, 2), limits = c(0, 12)) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("graph of f" = "#0072B2", "image of f" = "#D55E00")
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "Input, a (the roll)",
    y = "Output, f(a) = 2a",
    colour = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom")

if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  htmltools::div(
    role = "img",
    `aria-label` = fig_alt,
    plotly::ggplotly(doubling_die_plot) |>
      plotly::layout(legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.2))
  )
} else {
  doubling_die_plot
}
```

The [function](#def-function) $f(a) = 2a$ on the die rolls.
The six points are the [graph](#def-graph) of $f$.
The markers on the vertical axis are the [image of](#def-image) $f$:
only the multiples of $2$ from $2$ to $12$ are [values](#def-value) of $f$,
though the [codomain](#def-codomain) is all of $\reals$.

:::
